mcqs.question: In the anatomical position the palms face:
mcqs.explanation: Anatomical position has the palms facing forward with thumbs pointing away from the body.

mcqs.question: The plane that divides the body into front and back parts is the:
mcqs.explanation: The coronal (frontal) plane separates anterior from posterior.

mcqs.question: Turning the forearm so the palm faces backward or downward is called:
mcqs.explanation: Pronation turns the palm back/down; supination turns it forward/up.

mcqs.question: The trachea is lined by:
mcqs.explanation: Respiratory epithelium is pseudostratified ciliated columnar with goblet cells.

mcqs.question: Transitional epithelium is found in the:
mcqs.explanation: It flattens when the bladder stretches.

mcqs.question: Intervertebral discs are made of:
mcqs.explanation: Fibrocartilage is found in discs, symphysis pubis and menisci.

mcqs.question: Sebaceous glands are an example of:
mcqs.explanation: Whole cells break down to form sebum.

mcqs.question: Intercalated discs are a feature of:
mcqs.explanation: They join cardiac muscle cells end to end.

mcqs.question: The organelle that produces most of the cell's ATP is the:
mcqs.explanation: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration.

mcqs.question: The number of chromosomes in a human ovum is:
mcqs.explanation: Gametes are haploid (23); body cells have 46.

mcqs.question: The serous membrane covering the lungs is the:
mcqs.explanation: Pleura has visceral and parietal layers.

mcqs.question: The main muscle of inspiration is the:
mcqs.explanation: The diaphragm contracts and flattens to enlarge the thorax.

mcqs.question: The diaphragm is supplied by the:
mcqs.explanation: Phrenic nerve, C3–C5.

mcqs.question: An inhaled foreign body most often enters the:
mcqs.explanation: The right bronchus is shorter, wider and more vertical.

mcqs.question: The left lung has:
options: Two lobes and a cardiac notch
mcqs.explanation: Left lung: upper and lower lobes, oblique fissure, cardiac notch, lingula.

mcqs.question: Surfactant is secreted by:
mcqs.explanation: Type II pneumocytes make surfactant.

mcqs.question: The trachea divides at the level of the:
mcqs.explanation: The bifurcation (carina) lies at the sternal angle.

mcqs.question: The only complete cartilage ring of the airway is the:
mcqs.explanation: Tracheal rings are C-shaped; the cricoid is a full ring.

mcqs.question: The epiglottis is made of:
mcqs.explanation: Elastic cartilage gives it springiness.

mcqs.question: The oesophagus passes through the diaphragm at the level of:
mcqs.explanation: Caval T8, oesophageal T10, aortic T12.

mcqs.question: Quiet expiration is mainly due to:
options: Elastic recoil of lungs and chest wall
mcqs.explanation: Quiet expiration is passive.

mcqs.question: Parietal (oxyntic) cells of the stomach secrete:
mcqs.explanation: Chief cells make pepsinogen; G cells gastrin.

mcqs.question: The duct of the parotid gland opens opposite the:
mcqs.explanation: Stensen's duct opens on the cheek opposite the upper second molar.

mcqs.question: Peyer's patches are found mainly in the:
mcqs.explanation: They are aggregated lymphoid follicles in the ileum.

mcqs.question: The common bile duct is formed by the union of:
options: Cystic duct and common hepatic duct
mcqs.explanation: Cystic + common hepatic duct = common bile duct.

mcqs.question: The number of permanent teeth is:
mcqs.explanation: Deciduous teeth are 20.

mcqs.question: Kupffer cells are present in the:
mcqs.explanation: They are macrophages lining hepatic sinusoids.

mcqs.question: The extra oblique muscle layer is found in the wall of the:
mcqs.explanation: The stomach has three muscle layers for churning.

mcqs.question: Taeniae coli are features of the:
mcqs.explanation: Three longitudinal muscle bands of the colon.

mcqs.question: Lacteals in the villi absorb mainly:
mcqs.explanation: Fat enters lymph through the lacteal.

mcqs.question: Brunner's glands are located in the:
mcqs.explanation: They secrete alkaline mucus in the duodenal submucosa.

mcqs.question: The mitral valve lies between the:
mcqs.explanation: Mitral = bicuspid, left AV valve.

mcqs.question: The pacemaker of the heart is the:
mcqs.explanation: The SA node in the right atrium starts each beat.

mcqs.question: The vein most commonly used for venepuncture is the:
mcqs.explanation: It lies superficially in the cubital fossa.

mcqs.question: The apex beat is normally felt in the:
options: Left 7th intercostal space, anterior axillary line
mcqs.explanation: This is the position of the cardiac apex.

mcqs.question: Coronary arteries arise from the:
mcqs.explanation: They arise just above the aortic valve cusps.

mcqs.question: The innermost layer of the heart is the:
mcqs.explanation: Endocardium lines the chambers and covers the valves.

mcqs.question: The thoracic duct begins at the:
mcqs.explanation: It starts in the abdomen and drains into the left venous angle.

mcqs.question: The most numerous white blood cells are:
mcqs.explanation: Neutrophils form the largest share of WBCs.

mcqs.question: The cephalic vein runs along the:
mcqs.explanation: Basilic is medial; cephalic is lateral.

mcqs.question: Which branch does NOT arise from the arch of the aorta?
mcqs.explanation: The right common carotid arises from the brachiocephalic trunk.

mcqs.question: The pituitary gland lies in the:
options: Sella turcica of the sphenoid bone
mcqs.explanation: Also called the hypophyseal fossa.

mcqs.question: Calcitonin is secreted by the:
mcqs.explanation: C cells lie between thyroid follicles.

mcqs.question: The zona glomerulosa of the adrenal cortex secretes:
mcqs.explanation: Glomerulosa — salt (mineralocorticoids).

mcqs.question: The area of sharpest vision in the retina is the:
mcqs.explanation: It contains only cones.

mcqs.question: The organ of Corti is located in the:
mcqs.explanation: It is the receptor for hearing.

mcqs.question: Insulin is secreted by the:
mcqs.explanation: Beta cells are the majority of islet cells.

mcqs.question: The stratum lucidum is present only in:
options: Thick skin of palms and soles
mcqs.explanation: It is a clear layer found in thick skin.

mcqs.question: Taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue is carried by the:
mcqs.explanation: Via the chorda tympani branch.

mcqs.question: The ear ossicle attached to the tympanic membrane is the:
mcqs.explanation: The stapes fits into the oval window.

mcqs.question: To instil ear drops in an adult, the pinna is pulled:
mcqs.explanation: This straightens the adult canal; in young children pull down and back.

mcqs.question: The total number of bones in the adult human skeleton is:
mcqs.explanation: 80 axial + 126 appendicular.

mcqs.question: Growth in length of a long bone occurs at the:
mcqs.explanation: The growth plate ossifies after puberty.

mcqs.question: The hip joint is a:
mcqs.explanation: Femoral head in the acetabulum.

mcqs.question: The muscle used for the ventrogluteal injection site is the:
mcqs.explanation: Gluteus medius and minimus lie in the V between the fingers.

mcqs.question: The nerve at risk in a dorsogluteal injection is the:
mcqs.explanation: It runs deep in the buttock.

mcqs.question: The IM site of choice in infants is the:
mcqs.explanation: Thick muscle away from major nerves.

mcqs.question: Cells that break down bone are:
mcqs.explanation: Osteoblasts build; osteocytes maintain.

mcqs.question: The second cervical vertebra is called the:
mcqs.explanation: The axis carries the dens; C1 is the atlas.

mcqs.question: The joint between the atlas and axis is a:
mcqs.explanation: It allows rotation of the head.

mcqs.question: The deltoid muscle is supplied by the:
mcqs.explanation: The deltoid abducts the arm.

mcqs.question: The longest bone of the body is the:
mcqs.explanation: It is also the strongest.

mcqs.question: The structural and functional unit of the kidney is the:
mcqs.explanation: Each kidney has about a million nephrons.

mcqs.question: The length of the female urethra is about:
mcqs.explanation: Male urethra is 18–20 cm.

mcqs.question: The kidneys are:
mcqs.explanation: They lie behind the peritoneum on the posterior abdominal wall.

mcqs.question: Testosterone is secreted by the:
mcqs.explanation: Leydig cells lie between seminiferous tubules.

mcqs.question: Fertilisation usually occurs in the:
mcqs.explanation: The ampulla is the widest part of the tube.

mcqs.question: The muscle layer of the urinary bladder is the:
mcqs.explanation: Its contraction empties the bladder.

mcqs.question: The normal position of the uterus is:
mcqs.explanation: It tilts forward over the bladder.

mcqs.question: Most lymph from the breast drains to the:
mcqs.explanation: About three-quarters goes to the axilla.

mcqs.question: The renal corpuscle consists of:
options: Loop of Henle and collecting duct
mcqs.explanation: It is the filtering part of the nephron.

mcqs.question: The shortest and narrowest part of the male urethra is the:
mcqs.explanation: It passes through the external sphincter.

mcqs.question: The vital centres for breathing and heart rate are in the:
mcqs.explanation: Cardiac, respiratory and vasomotor centres.

mcqs.question: In adults the spinal cord ends at the level of:
mcqs.explanation: Lumbar puncture is done below this level.

mcqs.question: The number of pairs of spinal nerves is:
The primary motor area is in the:
mcqs.explanation: Postcentral gyrus is sensory.

mcqs.question: CSF is mainly formed by the:
mcqs.explanation: Mostly in the lateral ventricles.

mcqs.question: The third and fourth ventricles are connected by the:
mcqs.explanation: The aqueduct of Sylvius in the midbrain.

mcqs.question: Myelin in the peripheral nervous system is formed by:
mcqs.explanation: Oligodendrocytes myelinate CNS axons.

mcqs.question: The cranial nerve that supplies the lateral rectus is the:
mcqs.explanation: It turns the eye outward.

mcqs.question: Parasympathetic outflow is:
mcqs.explanation: Cranial nerves III, VII, IX, X and S2–S4.

mcqs.question: The coordination of movement and balance is a function of the:
mcqs.explanation: Damage gives ataxia.

mcqs.question: CSF is absorbed into venous blood through the:
mcqs.explanation: They project into the dural venous sinuses.
